messages.content: normalize.js is stable and correct per spec. No changes needed. Please review tokenizer.js for edge cases: it currently treats apostrophes as separators (e.g., don't -> don, t) and uses a manual ASCII alnum check. Ensure it handles empty normalized string and digit runs correctly. Let's finalize README example together.

Tokenizer implementation reviewed and remains unchanged. It correctly uses normalize(), treats apostrophes as separators, and keeps ASCII alphanumeric runs. No stopwords to discard. Ready for integration.
